package: @astryxdesign/lab

# ChatReactionBar

emoji reaction pills under a message; own reactions accent-tinted w/ aria-pressed; onAdd renders trailing add button opening ChatEmojiPicker popover

**Import:** `import {ChatReactionBar} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `reactions` | `{emoji: string; count: number; isSelected?: boolean; label?: string}[]` | - | {emoji,count,isSelected?,label?}[]; label doubles as tooltip + aria label **(required)** |
| `onToggle` | `(emoji: string) => void` | - | (emoji)=>void on pill click |
| `onAdd` | `(emoji: string) => void` | - | (emoji)=>void from picker; enables add button |
| `emojis` | `readonly ChatEmojiOption[]` | - | picker option override; default DEFAULT_CHAT_EMOJIS |
| `addLabel` | `string` | `'Add reaction'` | add button + picker dialog label |
| `label` | `string` | `'Reactions'` | group aria label |
